import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long P1_CONST = 998244353L;
    static final long P2_CONST = 1000000007L;
    static final long B_CONST = 1000000L;
    static List<Integer>[] seqs_arr = new ArrayList[7];
    static long[] prefix_sum_arr = new long[7];
    static long total_nums, order_idx, total_ans;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            seqs_arr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void build_sequences(long start, int depth) {
        order_idx++;
        seqs_arr[depth].add((int)((order_idx - start + P1_CONST) % P1_CONST));
        prefix_sum_arr[depth] = (prefix_sum_arr[depth] + seqs_arr[depth].get(seqs_arr[depth].size() - 1)) % P2_CONST;
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            build_sequences(start * 10 + digit, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    static void process(long x) {
        if (x > total_nums) return;
        if (x * B_CONST + B_CONST - 1 <= total_nums && x * B_CONST * 10 > total_nums) {
            long temp_order = order_idx;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                int size = seqs_arr[i].size();
                long delta = ((temp_order - x * (long)Math.pow(10, i)) % P1_CONST + P1_CONST) % P1_CONST;
                int pos = lowerBound(seqs_arr[i], (int)(P1_CONST - delta));
                total_ans = (total_ans + delta * size + prefix_sum_arr[i]) % P2_CONST;
                total_ans = (total_ans - (long)(size - pos) * P1_CONST + P2_CONST) % P2_CONST;
                order_idx += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        order_idx++;
        total_ans = (total_ans + ((order_idx - x) % P1_CONST + P1_CONST) % P1_CONST) % P2_CONST;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            process(x * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n_value = sc.nextLong();
        total_nums = n_value;
        build_sequences(0, 0);
        order_idx = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(seqs_arr[i]);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            process(i);
        }
        System.out.println(total_ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
